input.title: ZM Beta Player Messages - Team Note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
ZM Beta Player Messages: what we actually send (Oct 1, 2025)

1. Where retention stands: Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. The calls: 33 messages (14 PNs Beta rows + 19 asks), each run through the Beta message rule
- Go 3: Lives recharged (DES-315), Lapsed 1 day (DES-316), Lapsed 7 days (DES-317)
- Hold 23 (tickets moved to Backlog, unassigned, per the roadmap rule for held work until beta ships)
- Drop 7: Hourly Coins, Nathan's Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena (not in the beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days), Comeback gift on tap (v2), Rewarded ad ready (rewarded ads moved to Oct 21)
The PN sheet says six are Ready. Only three pass all six tests. Full list with reasons: "ZM Beta Player Messages - Calls (Oct 1 2025)" in the same folder.
One string change: Lapsed 7 days headline becomes "Your Squad Needs You Back" (Leonard's latest call, body stays). Client still ships "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?", so DES-347 is open to change it.

3. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day after the last session
(NotificationManager schedules these when the app goes to the background, and only for players who said yes to our own permission ask after level 20 or switched it on in settings)
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing..." (Lapsed 1 day; fires at the next server-day rollover)
- Days 2-6: nothing
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?" (Lapsed 7 days; new headline pending, DES-347)
- Days 8-13: nothing
- Day 14: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 21: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 28: same Lapsed 7 days message again (last one)
- Nothing after day 28. Day 3 (DES-342) and day 30 (DES-343) asks are Holds: the client doesn't schedule them. Day 14 (DES-344) is a Drop because the client already sends Lapsed 7 days that day.

4. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold, and why
- Finish first mission (DES-318), test 4 can't reach its players: it's written for new players below level 20, but our own permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call for beta) and the settings toggle doesn't count. None of the players it's for can get it. Vincent only saw it with notifications switched on from settings.
- Plague Race (DES-319), test 6 not seen on both platforms: Android 0.3.127 store build is fine, but Vincent's iPhone pass was on the 5-minute test build. On the iOS store build it never arrived. Daily is fine for this one.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320), test 5 wrong day: the client schedules it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the player's last session, not on the server's weekly reset day. So it says "Rankings reset" on a random weekday.

5. What's next
- Vincent: tick the three Go messages on the Push Notifications card checklist (ZM ROADMAP) as he re-checks them on store builds. Lapsed 7 days needs a re-check once DES-347 ships.
- Most Holds fail test 3: the client can send them with a local timer but NotificationManager doesn't schedule them yet. Six asks fail test 2 and need a server send: Endless weekly result, Season Pass premium nudge, Plague Race result, Support reply, New levels added. They stay in Backlog until after the beta build is out.

Done. 33 messages in total: the 14 PNs Beta rows plus 19 asks. Counts: **Go 3, Hold 23, Drop 7.**

• **Go (3):** Lives recharged, Lapsed 1 day, Lapsed 7 days. Your "Your Squad Needs You Back" headline for Lapsed 7 needs a string change, so I opened DES-347. These three are on a checklist on the Push Notifications card for Vincent.
• **Drop (7):** Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena aren't in the beta. Lapsed 14 days is already covered because the client re-sends Lapsed 7 on day 14. Comeback gift is v2. Rewarded ad ready moved to Oct 21.
• **Hold (23):** Three of these the client already schedules. Finish first mission can't reach anyone, because our own ask only runs after level 20. Plague Race never arrived on the iOS store build. Weekly Leaderboard fires 7 days after the last session instead of on reset day. Most of the rest just aren't scheduled yet, and 5 need a server send.

The sheet and the one-page note (Sep 15 cohort: iOS D1 31.65% / D7 9.28%, Android D1 37.86% / D7 10.68%) are in my Drive folder. Every ticket has the call as a comment. Drops are Canceled. Holds are in Backlog, unassigned, per your roadmap note. Win & Collect already had a ticket, Calvin's DES-313, so I didn't open a new one. I emailed each person who filed an ask.
